verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Misconception that halving wire radius doubles its resistance verified. Even at constant length, R is proportional to 1/A = 1/(pi*r^2), so halving r quadruples resistance (4x). Under volume conservation V = A*l = constant, halving r reduces A to A/4 and quadruples length to 4*l, compounding to R proportional to 1/r^4. Ratio R_new / R_old = (r_old / (r_old / 2))^4 = 2^4 = 16x increase, not 2x. Physical refutation, mathematical derivation, and corrective pedagogical exposition verified.
